detail.body:
Use `async_h2d` for Engram history seeding during PD decode admission.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:x: [Run #38959821161](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38959821161)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #38959820960](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38959820960)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:x: [Run #38959820857](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38959820857)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->
detail.title: [Fix] engram: Avoid blocking history copies during PD admission

files.patch:
@@ -181,16 +181,17 @@ def _prepare_engram_history(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> None:
             for req in batch.reqs:
                 # full_untruncated_fill_ids is only refreshed on the extend and
                 # decode paths, which a PD decode request has not run yet.
-                fill_ids = req.origin_input_ids + req.output_ids
-                end = len(fill_ids) - 1
-                ids = fill_ids[max(0, end - n1) : end]
+                # Slice the tail first: origin_input_ids can be ~100k tokens.
+                tail = (req.origin_input_ids[-(n1 + 1) :] + req.output_ids)[-(n1 + 1) :]
+                ids = tail[:-1]
                 rows.append([0] * (n1 - len(ids)) + list(ids))
-            slots = torch.tensor(
+            # Pinned copies keep the admission fence from stalling the CPU.
+            slots = async_h2d(
                 [req.kv.req_pool_idx for req in batch.reqs],
                 dtype=torch.int64,
                 device=history.device,
             )
-            history[slots] = torch.tensor(
+            history[slots] = async_h2d(
                 rows, dtype=history.dtype, device=history.device
             ).view(len(rows), n1)
             return
